remarks: Set on over two private acres with its own pond and just one mile from town, this architecturally significant modern residence is a rare convergence of design, technology, and setting. Custom designed by the owner, the home is defined by glass, steel, and wood construction, clean lines, and a west-facing orientation that fills the interiors with extraordinary natural light and sunset views. The home offers over 4,000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space across three finished levels, all with radiant heat and a layout that lives far beyond its one-bedroom designation. Supported by a three-bedroom septic system, the home includes multiple additional rooms that function beautifully as guest rooms, offices, gym space, media rooms, or creative studios, providing exceptional flexibility for today's lifestyles. Indoor and outdoor living blend seamlessly with patios off the kitchen, living room, and primary bedroom overlooking the pond. Outdoor amenities include landscape lighting, a gas firepit, outdoor bar seating, gas grill, and a heated exterior staircase to the lower level, making the property ideal for year-round entertaining. Interior highlights include extensive custom cabinetry, a soundproofed media room, speakers throughout the home, Savant smart home integration, and Nest cameras. Energy-efficient features include geothermal heating and cooling, solar panels, radiant heat on all floors, and a whole-house Generac gas generator.
